page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the title block centred at the top, followed by the running text below. No margin notes. Page number at the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: DAVIDIS PAREI Exercitationum Philosophicarum & Theologicarum
LIBER II.
Exercitationes Theologicas continens.
Exercitatio I.
Consultatio ad amicum de quaestione:

p.i: An liceat emere & possidere res preciosas Idololatriae dicatas.

main_text.head: PARS NEGANS.
main_text.p: EXordium ab occasione: Quod nuper No-vesio expugnato milites quidam vestimenta & vasa preciosa, Idololatrica, bello direpta,civibus vestrae urbis venalia, & quidem viliore precio obtulerint.

page.notes: The faint mirrored text in the left and right margins is show-through from the reverse side and is omitted. The large initial E of the paragraph beginning "Exordium" is a drop cap and is joined to the word. The spacing in "direpta,civibus" is as it appears on the scan and may be a printing error. The heading ornament at the top is decoration and is not transcribed.
